CISA Urges Patching Critical Vulnerability in BeyondTrust Remote Support
entry.summary: CISA is aware of critical authentication bypass vulnerability CVE-2026-102764, affecting BeyondTrust Remote Support (formerly Bomgar) versions 26.2.3 and earlier. Patches are available for supported versions (24.3.1 and later); organizations using older versions must upgrade first. Cyber threat actors are actively exploiting the vulnerability to gain initial access, then establishing persistence, escalating privileges, and moving laterally. entry.title: Critical Java Vulnerability Requires Immediate Patching
entry.summary: Purpose CISA strongly urges organizations to immediately patch the recently disclosed Oracle Java vulnerability CVE-2026-114938. This critical memory-corruption vulnerability, known as “Java4Shell,” affects the Base64 decoder of the x86-64 HotSpot Java Virtual Machine (JVM), which is part of the Java Development Kit (JDK).
